question: Does TS geometry carry channel-ranking information that the event does not, and does it arrive while the event can still change?

data_scope.split: V1a development parents only (62 parents, 21 formula groups)
data_scope.excluded: V1a screen parents and M0 official val/test; already analyzed, never used for direction choices

check_a_information_bound.unit: reference record of a development parent, read from the T1x cache in its own atom order and frame

predictors.E_frozen: frozen V1a h_E ensemble mean, state (b=b_p, x=x_r, t_b=1)
predictors.X_frozen: frozen V1a h_X ensemble mean, state (b=b_p, x=x_ts, t_b=1, t_x=1)
predictors.N_clean: matched retrained X-architecture ensemble fed (b=b_p, x=x_r, t_b=1, t_x=1)
predictors.G_clean: matched retrained X-architecture ensemble fed (b=b_p, x=x_ts, t_b=1, t_x=1)
predictors.xtb_ts: GFN2-xTB single point on the reference TS geometry, minus GFN2-xTB on the parent anchor reactant (kcal/mol)
predictors.oracle: catalogue barrier itself (sanity check, must give rho=1)

matched_training.labels: V1a ScoreRows: training-split parents, parent-balanced, catalogue barriers standardized by training median/IQR
matched_training.optimizer: same as V1a score heads (AdamW, V1a lr schedule, EMA 0.999, Huber delta 1, grad clip 1)
matched_training.pairing: both variants share member seed, initialization and batch order; only the geometry input differs

event_level.target: min catalogue barrier over the channel's records

metrics.primary: within-parent Spearman rho between predicted and catalogue channel barriers
secondary: top1: lowest-predicted channel is a best channel (ties shared)
concordance over channel pairs with |delta catalogue| >= 2 kcal/mol (prediction ties count 0.5)

reading.GEOMETRY_ADDS_RANKING_INFORMATION: two-sided lower bound of the primary difference > 0
reading.note: X_frozen-E_frozen is the main comparison; G_clean-N_clean is reported beside it and any disagreement is stated, not resolved

check_b_time_window.generator: frozen V1a joint generator (role joint, 60k steps), training seeds 0,1,2
check_b_time_window.predicted_endpoint: x1_hat(k) = x_k + (1 - t_k) * (x_{k+1} - x_k) / (t_{k+1} - t_k); same for b; step 50 is the final state
check_b_time_window.event_at_step: decode_be of b1_hat, then canonical_event if valid_endpoint, else invalid
check_b_time_window.commit_step: first step after which every decoded event equals the final event; trajectories with an invalid final event are excluded and counted

signals.xtb: GFN2-xTB energy of x1_hat(t) minus anchor reactant energy (kcal/mol); geometries with any interatomic distance < 0.5 A are not evaluated (NaN, counted)
signals.h_X: frozen V1a h_X ensemble mean on the current state (b_t, x_t, t_b=t, t_x=t), the quantity whose gradient B1 follows

targets.final_event_barrier: min catalogue barrier of the final decoded event; trajectories whose final event is outside the catalogue or invalid are excluded

check_b_time_window.correlation: Spearman within parent over all its eligible trajectories pooled across training seeds; needs >= 4 trajectories and >= 2 distinct target values
check_b_time_window.t_geo: first grid t whose parent-mean rho reaches 0.5 * rho(t=1), defined only when rho(t=1) has a two-sided lower bound > 0
check_b_time_window.window_fraction: share of valid-final trajectories whose commit time is later than t_geo
check_b_time_window.secondary_self_correction: share of valid-final trajectories whose decoded event at t=0.5 differs from the final one, and best-event hit rates for changed vs unchanged trajectories
